question: The movement responsible for drifting of the continents was caused by the polar-fleeing force and tidal force. The polar-fleeing force is related to:

options.text: gravitational attraction of the moon and sun

solution:
The correct answer is __**rotation of the earth**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The movement responsible for the drifting of the continents was caused by the** polar-fleeing force and tidal force**.
 
• The polar-fleeing force is related to the **rotation of the earth**.
